build_boost_mysql_docs: build the Boost.Mysql documentation by installing Boost, running b2, and copying HTML output to a known path
install_boost_for_docs: install a specific Boost branch with docs support enabled as a prerequisite for building documentation
write_user_config_jam: write a user-config.jam file to the home directory enabling doxygen and boostbook toolsets
run_b2_boostrelease: run b2 to build the Boost.Mysql documentation in release mode using the boostrelease target
copy_docs_to_output: copy the generated HTML documentation from the Boost root to a well-known output directory under the source
